Zakat is a yearly obligatory charity in Islam — 2.5% of qualifying wealth held for one lunar year. Enter what you own below to estimate it.
Zakat is due only if your net wealth is above the nisab — the value of 85g gold or 595g silver. Choose which to measure against; enter that metal\'s price below.
